title: Navy CIO: Investing in connectivity key to continued ‘maritime dominance’
summary: While ubiquitous connectivity is often taken for granted in today’s world, it will be essential to driving the Navy’s adoption of advanced technologies like autonomy and AI, even in degraded or denied environments, CIO Barry Tanner said.
